title: Review missing attachments before sending invitations
steps: Inspect the loaded English invitation template and its attachment error message for Community feedback.
Scroll to Invitation attachments and inspect participant-guide.pdf with its red missing-file marker.
Open the Participants link with Enter for the same survey and inspect Alex Morgan in the participant list.
Choose Invite & remind → Send email invitation and inspect the invitation form and Send invitations control.

video_guide.summary: Compare the attachment problem in the invitation template with the visible invitation preparation form.

chapters.note: The English invitation template displays an attachment-error banner.
participant-guide.pdf appears in Invitation attachments with a red warning marker and size 0 KB.
The participant list shows Alex Morgan.
The menu includes Send email invitation.
Send email invitations shows participant ID 1, a subject and message, and no attachment warning in the visible form.
The visible invitation form still has no attachment warning; the green Send invitations control is present.
